thesis: ASO has a strong relative-strength uptrend (close 70.49 above SMA20 64.01, SMA50 56.51, SMA200 53.16) and cheap multiples (forward P/E 9.96, EV/EBITDA 8.6), and the 67.8-69.5 pullback zone gives about 3.0 R to 75.1 against a 66.5 stop. But the last price of 70.49 sits above the zone, where R/R is only about 1.16. The run (+51% in 63 days) has no identified catalyst, RSI is about 70, and the regime is risk-off (confidence 0.8) with a hot-CPI headwind for consumer cyclicals. Hold now; it becomes actionable only if price fills the zone and the 66.5 low holds.
invalidation: A daily close below 66.5, or a failed break of the 71.29 high that closes back under 67.
key_risks: Risk-off regime: QQQ below its 50- and 200-day averages, VIX at the 0.877 percentile, ^TNX 5.141 and rising
Fiscal Q3 earnings on 2026-12-08 with about 19.9% short interest, so a gap through the 66.5 stop is possible (bear's downside level is 62.3, about -9.2% from 68.65)
Unexplained jumps of +11% on 11/4 and +6% on 11/9 with no confirmed catalyst; the extension may mean-revert toward SMA20 64.01
